text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about, I came 
across Tokai Teio and Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, what do you think? The limited-time 
'Special Honey Drink'! It's delicious, 
right~?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Humph, it goes down far smoother than I 
had imagined. The sweetness is not 
overpowering, striking a fine balance.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Plus, it uses top-notch honey, so 
drinking it makes you feel super 
energized~♪ And what's more, what's more—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Seeing that bursting vitality of 
yours, I can readily believe its purported 
efficacy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What say you, shall we find a quiet place 
to sit down and discuss the further hidden 
virtues of this beverage?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wait, really? Let's go, let's go—!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, no, no, no~!! That's not it! Today 
is supposed to be the day where I escort 
you, President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! Haha, that was indeed the 
arrangement. My apologies. I shall 
continue to leave matters in your hands, 
Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's play a shooting game! It's nice to 
play games like this once in a while, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's super thrilling and leaves you 
feeling completely refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, very well. Then lead the way. I must 
admit I am somewhat unaccustomed to such 
pastimes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, dodging that one, are you—then how 
about this!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! President, that was amazing! That 
was a rare enemy just now!! Hardly anyone 
manages to defeat it, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trivialities like that are swept aside 
with a single strike—whoops! Incoming from 
the right flank, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Phew... that worked up a good sweat. I see 
now, I believe I understand why you find 
this so captivating.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Really? If you enjoyed it, that makes me 
super happy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Though I didn't actually intend to make 
you run around and exert yourself that 
much~...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I said we should head up to the 
observation hill next! I'm in the mood to 
totally kick back and relax!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Phew... the breeze feels wonderful. This 
is indeed the perfect spot to stretch 
one's wings.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
! Isn't it great?! I'm gonna slack off and 
laze around too. Since it's just the two 
of us here anyway!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
These documents...! Don't tell me you 
compiled all of this yourself, President?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, it was an urgent matter, was it 
not? I heard you had other duties today, 
and my hands happened to be free, so—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Not! A-gain!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How many times must I repeat myself?! If 
you carry on like this, you will leave 
yourself with no time to rest whatsoever, 
President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I-I am eternally grateful for your 
consideration! However, it seems to be an 
incurable bad habit of mine—
(Knock knock, click)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo, President! Hey, hey! Wanna hang out 
together on our next day off?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...And so came the escort, I see.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, I was merely reflecting on how today 
has been a truly soothing moment of pure, 
unbound serenity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, it has been a long 
time since I last spent time simply 
enjoying myself as I pleased.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It has been a fine respite. You have my 
gratitude, Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, see, see? Even I can pull off 
something like this!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So from now on— no, feel free to rely on 
me even mo~re, okay?♪

I kept bumping into them wherever I went 
today... and witnessing their warm 
exchange brought a smile to my heart.
